# UrbanCadastral GIS Workstation

An interactive web-based GIS workstation for visualizing, inspecting, and exporting AI-detected building footprints from aerial and satellite imagery.

Built with **React 19**, **TypeScript**, and **Tailwind CSS**, communicating with the local FastAPI inference engine.

---

## Workstation Features

* **Real-Time Layer Modes:**
  * `RAW IMAGE`: Unprocessed high-resolution optical imagery (GeoTIFF preview or JPEG).
  * `AI BUILDING MASK`: Binary segmentation prediction raster generated by `LightUNet`.
  * `RAW + AI OVERLAY`: Semi-transparent amber mask blended over optical imagery with dynamic opacity controls ($0\%\text{--}100\%$).
* **Vectorized Polygon Layer:** Interactive SVG overlay rendering simplified, non-overlapping building footprint boundaries (green contours) in real-time.
* **Building Inspector:** Click or hover any detected building polygon to inspect:
  * Unique Building ID (e.g., `BLD-004`)
  * Model Confidence percentage
  * Footprint Area (pixel area / spatial area)
  * Georeferencing status & coordinate reference system
* **GeoJSON Export:** One-click download of WGS 84 (`EPSG:4326` / `CRS84`) or pixel-coordinate FeatureCollection GeoJSON files directly from the UI.
* **Preset Selector & Custom Upload:** Includes 4 pre-configured validation scenes (residential, townhomes, standard JPEG, and external drone orthophoto) alongside drag-and-drop file upload.
* **Non-Georeferenced Coordinate Guard:** Visual warning banner displayed whenever imagery lacks spatial CRS headers, maintaining coordinate integrity without fabricating geographic data.

---

## Development Setup

### 1. Prerequisites
* Node.js 18+ & npm

### 2. Install Dependencies
```bash
npm install
```

### 3. Start Development Server
```bash
npm run dev
```
The application will launch on `http://localhost:5174/` with automatic proxying to the FastAPI backend (`http://127.0.0.1:8000/`).

### 4. Production Build
```bash
npm run build
```
Executes TypeScript type-checking (`tsc -b`) and Vite production bundling.
